notes: MazF vs empty vector (pBAD30) in MG1655 delta_mazF, arabinose-induced 5/30/60 min after shift to glucose-free M9+casamino acids+glycerol. Empty-vector samples (induced) are controls at 5 and 30 min. Carbon source set to mixed (glycerol + casamino acids + arabinose inducer after glucose removal). Phase mid_exponential inferred from OD ~0.35 before the shift (all samples <=2 h). Ribo-Zero samples depletion, total RNA samples none.
